review_input.sha256_meaning: Historical first250 input bytes, not an assertion that the regenerated dynamic C01 audit remains unchanged.

policy.unknown_rule: Any unconfirmed protocol/owner remains UNKNOWN for Root; no default PASS or guessed card.
policy.historical_fixture_rule: Baseline/shim paths have their real diagnostic purpose and are never treated as current production implementations.
policy.phase_rule: Plan phase/batch responsibility is not a new execution dependency or a declaration that a later whole card has been implemented.
policy.current_worktree_rule: current_sha256 binds actual working bytes. If current_head_bytes_equal_worktree=false, source_commits identify only committed antecedents; the working diff remains explicit, not an invented commit.
policy.execution_during_audit: No build/test/instrumentation executed by this ownership review; existing evidence refs are references only.
policy.self_dynamic_hash_policy: SELF_FINAL_GIT_TREE_BINDING / FINAL_COMMIT_BINDING; no fabricated self hashes
policy.derived_execution_ledger_binding: The four derived execution/status ledgers bind to the final containing Git tree, like the registry and C01 receipt; this never grants implementation acceptance.
